## Problem and result

Explain the requirement, the change, and the resulting behavior or documentation.

## Validation

List checks actually performed and their results. Identify anything not tested and why.

## Risks and open items

Describe relevant security, operational, and cost implications. Link material ADRs and any related issue. Include cleanup or rollback steps where applicable.

## Review
